page.title: 名詞のうしろに、説明をつなぐ

analysis.summaryJa: このページは関係節を、説明したい名詞というターゲットと、その名詞が入る役割を欠いた後続文をつなぐ仕組みとして導入する。who・which・that・where・when・whyは暗記語ではなく、先行詞と主語・目的語・場所・時・理由の穴を対応させる案内役として捉える。
grammarPoints: 関係節は説明したい名詞の直後に置く
後続節には先行詞が担当する主語・目的語などの役割が欠けている
人の主語・目的語の穴はwhoでつなげる
物の主語・目的語の穴はwhichでつなげる
thatは制限用法で人・物のどちらにも使える
場所の副詞的な穴にはwhere、時にはwhen、理由にはwhyを使う
目的語の関係語は省略できる場合があるが主語の関係語は省略できない
関係語を置いた後に同じ役割の代名詞を重ねない
visualEvidence: TARGET名詞ブロックと欠けた文の線路を橋で結ぶ図が中心にある
WHO人、WHICHもの、WHERE場所、WHEN時、WHY理由の案内標識が穴の種類を示している
説明したい名詞を置く、穴を作る、関係語でつなぐという三段階が矢印で示されている
ミニ問題ではlostの目的語位置にkeyが入ることが光る空所で可視化されている
commonTraps: 先行詞だけを見て関係語を選び、後続節の穴を確認しない
関係節を説明対象から離れた位置に置く
whoの後ろにhe、whichの後ろにitを重ねる
場所を表す名詞なら常にwhereを選ぶ
目的語の穴がない完全な文にwhichを入れる
主語の関係語を省略する
二つの独立文をそのまま並べて関係節にしたつもりになる

questions.prompt: The consultant ------- prepared the market forecast will join today’s call.
questions.translationJa: 市場予測を作成したコンサルタントが本日の電話会議に参加します。
questions.explanationJa: 後続節preparedの主語が欠け、その役割を人consultantが担うためwhoです。

questions.prompt: We replaced the scanner ------- was causing repeated errors.
questions.translationJa: 私たちは繰り返しエラーを起こしていたスキャナーを交換しました。
questions.explanationJa: 物scannerがwas causingの主語になるためwhichでつなぎます。

questions.prompt: The applicant ------- the panel interviewed has accepted our offer.
questions.translationJa: 委員会が面接した応募者は当社の内定を受諾しました。
questions.explanationJa: the panel interviewedの目的語が欠け、その人をapplicantが表すのでwhoです。

questions.prompt: Please review the contract ------- I sent this morning.
questions.translationJa: 今朝送った契約書を確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: I sentの目的語が欠け、物contractを受けるthatが適切です。

questions.prompt: This is the loading area ------- overseas shipments are inspected.
questions.translationJa: ここが海外向け貨物を検査する荷役区域です。
questions.explanationJa: 後続節は主語と目的語がそろい、欠けるのは「その区域で」という場所情報なのでwhereです。

questions.prompt: Friday is the day ------- the maintenance crew will test the alarms.
questions.translationJa: 金曜日が保守作業員が警報器を試験する日です。
questions.explanationJa: 後続節に欠けている「その日に」という時の情報をwhenがつなぎます。

questions.prompt: The director explained the reason ------- the launch had been postponed.
questions.translationJa: 取締役は発売が延期された理由を説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 先行詞reasonに対応する「その理由で」という穴をwhyで示します。

questions.prompt: The route ------- the driver recommended avoids the construction zone.
questions.translationJa: 運転手が勧めた経路は工事区域を避けます。
questions.explanationJa: the driver recommendedの目的語が欠け、物routeをthatで受けます。

questions.prompt: Customers ------- need assistance should press the blue button.
questions.translationJa: 支援が必要なお客様は青いボタンを押してください。
questions.explanationJa: needの主語が欠けているため主格whoが必要です。目的格whomではありません。

questions.prompt: The warehouse ------- we store returned items is behind Building C.
questions.translationJa: 返品商品を保管する倉庫はC棟の裏にあります。
questions.explanationJa: we store returned itemsは完全な文で、欠けるのは保管場所なのでwhereです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a person as the subject of the relative clause.

choices.A: The engineer who she designed the system will lead the demonstration.
choices.B: The engineer designed who the system will lead the demonstration.
choices.C: The engineer who designed the system will lead the demonstration.
choices.D: The engineer which designed the system will lead the demonstration.

questions.translationJa: そのシステムを設計した技術者が実演を率います。
questions.explanationJa: who自体がdesignedの主語なので、余分なsheを置きません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a thing as the subject of the relative clause.

choices.A: The software which it monitors inventory sends an alert automatically.
choices.B: The software where monitors inventory sends an alert automatically.
choices.C: The software monitors which inventory sends an alert automatically.
choices.D: The software which monitors inventory sends an alert automatically.

questions.translationJa: 在庫を監視するソフトウェアは自動的に警告を送ります。
questions.explanationJa: whichがmonitorsの主語としてsoftwareを受けます。itを重ねてはいけません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a person as the object of the relative clause.

choices.A: The trainer who we invited is available on Tuesday.
choices.B: The trainer who we invited her is available on Tuesday.
choices.C: The trainer who invited we is available on Tuesday.
choices.D: The trainer where we invited is available on Tuesday.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが招待した講師は火曜日に対応できます。
questions.explanationJa: we invitedの目的語の穴にtrainerが入り、whoの後ろには主語weが続きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a thing as the object of the relative clause.

choices.A: The invoice that you requested it is attached to this message.
choices.B: The invoice that you requested is attached to this message.
choices.C: The invoice where you requested is attached to this message.
choices.D: The invoice that requested you is attached to this message.

questions.translationJa: ご依頼の請求書をこのメッセージに添付しています。
questions.explanationJa: you requestedの目的語の穴をthatが案内し、itは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a place.

choices.A: The lounge which visitors can charge phones is on the second floor.
choices.B: The lounge where visitors can charge phones there is on the second floor.
choices.C: The lounge where visitors can charge phones is on the second floor.
choices.D: The lounge who visitors can charge phones is on the second floor.

questions.translationJa: 来訪者が携帯電話を充電できるラウンジは2階です。
questions.explanationJa: 節に必要なのは「そのラウンジで」という場所情報なのでwhereを使い、thereは重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a time.

choices.A: August is the month which our annual inspection takes place it.
choices.B: August is the month when our annual inspection takes place then.
choices.C: August is the month who our annual inspection takes place.
choices.D: August is the month when our annual inspection takes place.

questions.translationJa: 8月は年次点検が行われる月です。
questions.explanationJa: takes placeに欠ける時の情報をwhenが補い、thenは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a reason.

choices.A: We understand the reason why the customer canceled the order.
choices.B: We understand the reason why the customer canceled the order for it.
choices.C: We understand the reason where the customer canceled the order.
choices.D: We understand why the reason the customer canceled the order.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは顧客が注文を取り消した理由を理解しています。
questions.explanationJa: reasonを受けるwhyが理由のつながりを示し、for itを重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with the relative clause next to its target noun.

choices.A: We hired who speaks three languages a coordinator.
choices.B: We hired a coordinator who speaks three languages.
choices.C: Who speaks three languages we hired a coordinator.
choices.D: We hired a coordinator, and who speaks three languages it.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは3言語を話すコーディネーターを採用しました。
questions.explanationJa: 説明節who speaks ...は説明対象coordinatorの直後に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence in which an object relative word is omitted.

choices.A: The proposal approved the committee will take effect next month.
choices.B: The proposal the committee approved it will take effect next month.
choices.C: The proposal the committee approved will take effect next month.
choices.D: The proposal the committee will take effect approved next month.

questions.translationJa: 委員会が承認した提案は来月発効します。
questions.explanationJa: the committee approvedの目的語の穴がproposalを受けるため、目的格thatを省略できます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence in which the subject relative word is retained.

choices.A: The package arrived this morning is for the sales team.
choices.B: The package that it arrived this morning is for the sales team.
choices.C: The package which this morning arrived it is for the sales team.
choices.D: The package that arrived this morning is for the sales team.

questions.translationJa: 今朝到着した荷物は営業チーム宛てです。
questions.explanationJa: thatがarrivedの主語なので省略できず、itも追加しません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The clerk who answered my call was helpful.”

choices.A: I answered a helpful clerk’s call.
choices.B: The clerk answered my call, and that clerk was helpful.
choices.D: The clerk helped me call someone else.

questions.translationJa: 私の電話に出た店員は親切でした。
questions.explanationJa: who answered my callがどのclerkかを特定し、その人がhelpfulだったと述べています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The device which records room temperature needs a new battery.”

choices.A: The device records room temperature, and it needs a new battery.
choices.B: Room temperature needs a device and a battery.
choices.C: A new battery records the device’s temperature.
choices.D: The device needs someone to record its purchase price.

questions.translationJa: 室温を記録する装置には新しい電池が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: which records ...はdeviceを主語とする説明です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager who we met oversees the eastern region.”

choices.A: The manager met us because we oversee the eastern region.
choices.B: We met every manager in the eastern region.
choices.C: The eastern region met the manager.
choices.D: We met the manager, and that manager oversees the eastern region.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが会ったマネージャーは東部地域を統括しています。
questions.explanationJa: we metの目的語がmanagerで、そのmanagerについて主節が説明しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The brochure that Maya designed won an award.”

choices.A: The award designed a brochure for Maya.
choices.B: Maya won a brochure instead of an award.
choices.C: Maya designed the brochure, and the brochure won an award.

questions.translationJa: マヤがデザインしたパンフレットが賞を受賞しました。
questions.explanationJa: thatはdesignedの目的語としてbrochureを受け、二つの情報を一文にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “This is the office where visitors collect badges.”

choices.A: Visitors collect the office as a badge.
choices.B: Visitors collect badges in this office.
choices.C: This office collects visitors’ badges automatically.
choices.D: Visitors ask which office designed the badges.

questions.translationJa: ここが来訪者がバッジを受け取る事務所です。
questions.explanationJa: whereはin this officeに相当する場所情報を節へ戻します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Monday is the day when new employees receive orientation.”

choices.A: New employees receive orientation on Monday.
choices.C: Monday receives orientation from new employees.
choices.D: Orientation replaces Monday for new employees.

questions.translationJa: 月曜日が新人研修を受ける日です。
questions.explanationJa: whenはon Mondayに相当する時の情報を関係節へつなぎます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We discovered the reason why the payment failed.”

choices.A: We discovered where the payment was stored.
choices.B: The failed payment discovered our reason.
choices.C: We paid because the discovery failed.
choices.D: We discovered what caused the payment to fail.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは支払いが失敗した理由を突き止めました。
questions.explanationJa: the reason whyは原因・理由の内容を示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The samples we received are being tested.”

choices.A: The samples received us for testing.
choices.B: We are being tested by someone who received samples.
choices.C: We received the samples, and those samples are being tested.
choices.D: We tested samples before receiving them.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが受け取ったサンプルは試験中です。
questions.explanationJa: 省略された目的格関係詞の後ろではwe receivedの目的語がsamplesです。
questions.focus: 省略された目的語の穴

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The employee that handles refunds is absent.”

choices.B: The employee handles refunds and is absent today.
choices.C: An absent customer handles the employee.
choices.D: The employee omitted the refund handler.

questions.translationJa: 返金を担当する従業員は不在です。
questions.explanationJa: thatはhandlesの主語でemployeeを受けています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The hall where the ceremony took place has been renovated.”

choices.A: The ceremony took place in the hall, and the hall has been renovated.
choices.B: The ceremony renovated the hall before taking place.
choices.C: The hall took the ceremony to another place.
choices.D: A renovated ceremony was held outside the hall.

questions.translationJa: 式典が行われたホールは改装されました。
questions.explanationJa: whereはin the hallという場所関係を表し、主節はそのhallについて述べます。

questions.prompt: “Which employee should receive this access card?” “The technician ------- starts the evening shift.”
questions.translationJa: 「このアクセスカードはどの従業員に渡しますか」「夜勤を始める技術者です」
questions.explanationJa: startsの主語となる人technicianをwhoで特定します。

questions.prompt: “Which printer needs service?” “The one ------- keeps jamming near the exit tray.”
questions.translationJa: 「どのプリンターを修理する必要がありますか」「排紙口付近で紙詰まりを繰り返すものです」
questions.explanationJa: 物printerがkeepsの主語になるためthatが適切です。

questions.prompt: “Do you know the visitor?” “Yes, she is the client ------- I called yesterday.”
questions.translationJa: 「その来訪者を知っていますか」「はい、昨日私が電話した顧客です」
questions.explanationJa: I calledの目的語の穴に人clientが入るためwhoです。

questions.prompt: “Which document should I archive?” “The report ------- the auditor signed.”
questions.translationJa: 「どの文書を保管しますか」「監査担当者が署名した報告書です」
questions.explanationJa: the auditor signedの目的語の穴を物reportが埋めるのでthatです。

questions.prompt: “Where will the interviews be held?” “In the room ------- we held last month’s workshop.”
questions.translationJa: 「面接はどこで行いますか」「先月の研修会を開いた部屋です」
questions.explanationJa: 節はwe held last month’s workshopで完全なので、欠ける場所情報をwhereが補います。

questions.prompt: “When does demand usually peak?” “December is the month ------- orders rise sharply.”
questions.translationJa: 「需要は通常いつ最大になりますか」「12月が注文が急増する月です」
questions.explanationJa: orders rise sharplyに欠ける時の情報をwhenでつなぎます。

questions.prompt: “Why was the reservation canceled?” “We still do not know the reason ------- it disappeared from the system.”
questions.translationJa: 「なぜ予約が取り消されたのですか」「システムから消えた理由はまだ分かりません」
questions.explanationJa: reasonに続いて理由内容を示す節をwhyでつなぎます。

questions.prompt: The replacement cable ------- you ordered has arrived at the service desk.
questions.translationJa: あなたが注文した交換用ケーブルがサービスデスクに届きました。
questions.explanationJa: you orderedの目的語が欠けており、物cableをthatで受けます。

questions.prompt: Anyone ------- plans to use the laboratory must complete safety training.
questions.translationJa: 研究室を利用する予定の人は全員、安全研修を修了しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: plansの主語が欠けているのでwhoを省略せず置きます。

questions.prompt: The café ------- our team meets after work closes at nine.
questions.translationJa: 仕事後に私たちのチームが集まるカフェは9時に閉店します。
questions.explanationJa: our team meetsは主語と動詞がそろい、欠ける「そのカフェで」をwhereが表します。
questions.focus: 場所名詞と節の完全性
